en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Musna, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the man who performs Tawaaf without being in ablution. Can he count that as the Tawaaf?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muthanna’ from Zurarah who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs Tawaf without wudu’; if such Tawaf is counted.
He (the Imam) said, ‘No, it is not counted.’”
